subject: Coordination: virtual onsite for Priya Sharma — rotational slot grid & synchronous debrief
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, TalentOps <talentops@recruiterco.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Coordination: virtual onsite for Priya Sharma — rotational slot grid & synchronous debrief

Hi all,

We have Priya Sharma (applied for Senior Infra Engineer) tentatively available for a virtual onsite next Monday-Tuesday (May 31–June 1). TalentOps sent candidate availability below — Priya prefers early PST windows. I want to propose a rotational slot grid that lets us run two parallel tracks in the morning (3 interviews each) and converge for a synchronous 30-min debrief right after the last slot. Key goals: reduce candidate fatigue, ensure evaluator parity, and keep buffer windows for overruns.

I attached a working rotation-grid CSV and Priya's resume. Please review and reply with:
- which panel/order you'd prefer to be in (A or B)
- any hard constraints (no back-to-back, lunch preference, timezone issues)
- whether you can take debrief ownership (lead the scoring sync)

Proposed minimal schedule (PST):
- Day 1 (Mon 5/31): Track A 08:30–11:00 (3 x 40m), Track B 09:00–11:30 (3 x 40m) — overlap window for panel transition at 10:15
- Debrief: 11:45–12:15 (30m) consolidated panel debrief (all interviewers join)
- Day 2 (Tue 6/1): follow-ups + system design deep-dive if advanced

Notes:
- We'll use Zoom links per slot; I can create calendar invites once we lock panels.
- Please add any proposed moderation notes to the rotation grid (attached).

Thanks,
Logan

--
Logan Wright
Hiring Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, TalentOps <talentops@recruiterco.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: virtual onsite for Priya Sharma — rotational slot grid & synchronous debrief

Thanks Logan — I can take Track A in the early slot, but prefer not to be immediately after the coding exercise (I need a 15m buffer). If Track A is 08:30 start, put me in slot 1 (08:30–09:10) and schedule a 15m break before the next interviewer takes over.

I volunteer to chair the debrief if Laura can't lead — I find a tight agenda helps (1) top-3 strengths, (2) top-3 risks, (3) recommended hire/skip/loop. I also updated the rotation-grid with an evaluator parity column (so both tracks have at least one backend lead + one infra scale reviewer).

Lauren
Sr Staff SWE, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: virtual onsite for Priya Sharma — rotational slot grid & synchronous debrief

Couple of operational asks:
- Please make the debrief a strict 30m with assigned lead. If we need more time, we can reconvene asynchronously in the hiring doc.
- I'll bring the debrief-rubric-v2.docx (attached) with calibrated scoring ranges (1–4) to keep recommendations consistent across panels.
- For buffer policy: suggest a 10-minute grace window, after which the candidate stays and the next panel swaps in (we've done this before).

Tessa — can you confirm your timezone (I have you in EDT) and whether you can do the 09:00 start for Track B?

Thanks,
Laura
Engineering Manager, Core Systems
Redwood Inference
From: TalentOps <talentops@recruiterco.com>

Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coordination: virtual onsite for Priya Sharma — rotational slot grid & synchronous debrief

Hi team — Priya confirmed availability for both days and prefers the early PST windows (08:30–12:30). Candidate details:
- Priya Sharma, current location: Seattle (PST)
- Resume attached (priya-sharma-resume.pdf)
- Needs 20 min for a short take-home exercise prior to her first slot on Day 1 (we scheduled that for 07:45–08:05 PST)

She asked if we can avoid scheduling more than two interviews back-to-back without a 15-min break; she has a mild hearing accommodation request (prefers captions on Zoom). Please ensure captions are enabled on the meeting links.

Let me know if any of the proposed slots don't work and I'll reprioritize interviewers.

Best,
TalentOps
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 14:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coordination: virtual onsite for Priya Sharma — rotational slot grid & synchronous debrief

Confirming: I'm EDT (UTC-4) and can do the 09:00 PST start for Track B (that's 12:00 my time). I prefer not to be in the follow-up deep-dive on Day 2 — my schedule is tight that afternoon.

One operational question: who owns the candidate feedback doc? If we keep everything in the hiring doc, can we agree that each interviewer adds a 3–4 sentence rationale immediately after the debrief? I can take notes during debrief if Lauren leads the session.

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@example.com>, TalentOps <talentops@recruiterco.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Final schedule: Priya Sharma virtual onsite — confirmed slots + calendar invites

Thanks everyone for the quick responses — finalizing schedule and notes below. I created calendar invites and Zoom links (links in calendar invites). Zoom captions enabled per candidate accommodation. Attachments included: rotation-grid-20270530.csv and debrief-rubric-v2.docx.

Final Day 1 (Mon 2027-05-31 PST):
- 07:45–08:05 Take-home check-in (TalentOps / Priya)
- Track A (Lauren lead): 08:30–09:10 Lauren (backend scale)
- Track B: 09:00–09:40 Tessa (UX infra perspective)
- 09:20–10:00 Laura (infra reliability)
- 10:15–10:55 Panel swap / second interviewer (see rotation-grid)
- Debrief (mandatory for all interviewers): 11:45–12:15 — Lauren will chair; Tessa will take notes

Day 2 (Tue 2027-06-01 PST):
- Optional follow-ups / system design deep-dive 09:00–11:00 (Laura and Logan facilitating)

Operational items:
- Debrief owner: Lauren (will capture consensus in the hiring doc within 1 hour of the debrief)
- Scoring: use debrief-rubric-v2.docx attached; each interviewer to add a 3–4 sentence rationale post-debrief
- Buffer policy: 10m grace, then swap in next panelist; we aim to finish the day's interviews by 12:15 PST
- Attachments: priya-sharma-resume.pdf, rotation-grid-20270530.csv, debrief-rubric-v2.docx

If no objections by EOD PST today I'll send the calendar invites officially. Otherwise flag conflicts here.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Logan
Hiring Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
